item.title: [Due in 5 days] Azure Virtual Desktop (Classic) retires
[Due today] Legacy Whiteboard migration tooling retires 25 Sep; unmigrated boards are deleted 16 Oct
[Due in 6 days] Insider Risk Management retires the 'Alerts (classic)' tab on 1 Oct 2026 for the unified alert queue
[Due in 6 days] Anomaly Detector, Metrics Advisor and Personalizer retire on 1 October 2026
[Due in 5 days] Purview data risk graph deprecated: configuration ends 30 September in Data Security Investigations, retired 24 November in Insider Risk Management
[Due in 5 days] User.ReadBasic.All stops returning app role assignments and licence details — a security fix, live this month
[New] Security Copilot agents arrive in Defender, Entra, Intune and Purview with the E5/E7 entitlement, no purchase and no opt-in
[New] Eleven profile card properties become visible by default in late October unless you hide them with Graph first
[New] Defender gets native case management: analyst assignment, SLA tracking and notes in the portal
[New] DLP lets you point the Copilot access-restriction link at your own compliance page instead of Microsoft's docs
[New] Microsoft cancels auto-labeling for Azure Storage and Azure SQL after two years of preview
[New] Adaptive Protection reaches Data Lifecycle Management: content deleted by elevated-risk users is retained for 120 days
[New] Teams will detect and label external meeting bots, and the GA completion date slips to end of October
[New] Microsoft's DCU disrupts EvilTokens, a phishing-as-a-service platform built around device code flow and token theft
[New] Microsoft publishes Storm-2570's repeated tradecraft across deployments, not just its ransomware payload
[New] Intune publishes its Apple OS 27 support: new declarative device management settings and platform changes
[New] Microsoft is changing which documentation repositories are public, and nine of the nineteen mirrors this brief clones no longer answer
[New] The endpoint map catches up with the 24 September permissions sync: three permissions, three more endpoints
[New] The Message Center index is now read whole — 2,497 rows in one request — and its date column turns out to be Last updated, not Published
[New] The community feeds had not been refetched since 20 September; today's sweep of all 58 admits 95 articles the brief had never held
